name: tm2
description: Make, read and change .tm2 label files for KING JIM's TEPRA LINK 2 app.
long_description: Ask for labels in your own words. Claude writes a `.tm2` file, and you print it from TEPRA LINK 2 on your phone. It can also read a `.tm2` file and change it, one the app saved too. The tools write a file. They do not print.

tools.name: create_text_label
tools.description: Write a .tm2 file that prints one label of text.

tools.name: create_label_pages
tools.description: Write a .tm2 file that prints one label per string, each on a page of its own.

tools.name: create_pour_labels
tools.description: Write a .tm2 file that prints one label per string through the app's pour form, for QR codes and barcodes.

tools.name: edit_label
tools.description: Change a .tm2 file by a JSON Patch.
